info.name: Student Marks API
info.description: deliverable: authentication, students, courses, enrollments, statistics, transcripts and health.

exec: pm.test("Token is returned", () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.token).to.be.a("string").and.not.empty; });
pm.test("Token is returned", () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.token).to.be.a("string").and.not.empty; });
const j = pm.response.json(); if (j.studentId) { pm.environment.set("studentId", String(j.studentId)); }
pm.test("PostgreSQL check is present", () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.checks.some(c => c.name === "postgresql")).to.be.true; });

const j = pm.response.json(); const current = Number(pm.environment.get("studentId") || 1); const other = (j.items || []).find(s => s.id !== current); if (other) { pm.environment.set("otherStudentId", String(other.id)); }
const j = pm.response.json(); pm.test("Student id is returned", () => pm.expect(j.id).to.be.a("number"));
pm.test("Full name was updated", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().fullName).to.eql("Postman Student Updated"));
const j = pm.response.json(); pm.test("Course id is returned", () => pm.expect(j.id).to.be.a("number"));
const j = pm.response.json(); pm.test("Enrollment id is returned", () => pm.expect(j.id).to.be.a("number"));
pm.test("Pass mark is configured to 50", () => pm.expect(j.passMark).to.eql(50));
